question.text: In the FIU-IND vs Way2Wealth Brokers Private Limited case, what was the primary violation found?

answer.text: Failure to properly raise, investigate alerts, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) with FIU-IND
Failure to collect PAN from clients
Failure to register as a stockbroker with SEBI
Failure to pay service tax to the government

explanation.text: The Logic: Way2Wealth was found to have breached obligations regarding: (1) failure to properly raise, investigate alerts, handle alerts, and file STRs for underlying transactions in December 2021, and (2) failure to consider adverse SEBI orders from an AML monitoring perspective. A penalty of Rs. 1 Lakh was imposed under Section 13(2)(d) of PMLA. The Trap: The case was NOT about basic KYC failures like PAN collection. It was specifically about the STR process -- the broker detected alerts but failed to properly investigate and report them.
